adjudication.rationale: In packages/lib/CalendarService.ts, BaseCalendarService.createEvent now destructures only the first destination calendar (`const [mainHostDestinationCalendar] = event.destinationCalendar ?? []`) and filters the CalDAV calendars list solely against that externalId: `filter((c) => mainHostDestinationCalendar?.externalId ? c.externalId === mainHostDestinationCalendar.externalId : true)`. With the diff-wide change of `destinationCalendar` to an array and EventManager creating events per-destination/credential, a co-host’s CalDAV credential can receive an event whose `destinationCalendar[0]` belongs to a different credential, causing this filter to match nothing and thus create no event for that credential (Promise.all on an empty array).
